source: Homepage and recent update at https://www.turn2us.org.uk/about-us/news-and-media/latest-news/what-does-the-2026-autumn-budget-mean-for-you (verified 2026-11-10).

name: UK Humanitarian Innovation Hub (UKHIH)
what: The UK Humanitarian Innovation Hub is a UK-funded programme that brings government, science, private and humanitarian actors together. It supports innovations and technologies for humanitarian responses to disasters and conflict.
source: DevTracker programme page at https://devtracker.fcdo.gov.uk/programme/GB-CHC-1177110-UKHIH/summary (accessed 2026-11-10). Supports name, what, region and website. Quote for what: "The UK Humanitarian Innovation Hub (UKHIH) will promote and support strategic and focused collaborations across government, science, private and humanitarian actors to drive urgently needed innovations and technologies in humanitarian responses to disasters and conflict." The page describes a UK Government-funded programme with global projects, so region is national.

name: Water Testing River Thames (WTRT)
what: Water Testing River Thames is a volunteer group testing water quality along the River Thames from Oxford to Teddington. It publishes E. coli and intestinal enterococci results as open data.
source: what, website, region and takes_contributors from https://watertestingriverthames.co.uk/ and https://watertestingriverthames.co.uk/about_us (accessed 2026-11-10; HTTP 200). what quote: "Volunteer test results for E. coli and intestinal enterococci from Oxford to Teddington." About quote: "volunteers testing water quality on the River Thames from Oxford to Teddington, and why we share the results." The contact page invites questions, offers of help and reports, which supports takes_contributors.

name: Web Science Institute
what: The Web Science Institute is a research institute at the University of Southampton that studies web science, data science and artificial intelligence. Its work examines the social challenges and opportunities created by online technologies, including privacy, data and trust in AI.
source: https://www.southampton.ac.uk/research/institutes-centres/web-science-institute (accessed 2026-11-10). Supports name, domain, what, region, website and linkedin_org. Homepage quote for what: "Web Science Institute explores the challenges and opportunities it brings to society, from issues around privacy and data to the notion of trust in AI." Region from the page metadata "og:region: Southampton" and the Southampton address. The homepage linked linkedin_org. Tags from the same page.

name: Whistleblowing International Network
what: The Whistleblowing International Network is an international charity based in Scotland that supports civil society organisations defending whistleblowers. It provides tools, expertise and a shared platform, and runs the EU Whistleblowing Monitor to track whistleblowing law across Europe.
source: https://whistleblowingnetwork.org/Home and https://whistleblowingnetwork.org/About (accessed 2026-11-10). Supports name, domain, what, region, website, linkedin_org, events_url, founding_year and takes_contributors. Homepage quote for what: "WIN connects and strengthens civil society organisations that defend and support whistleblowers." About quote for founding_year: "Established in 2018, WIN is a global whistleblowing membership network and the information hub for the whistleblower protection community." The About page gives the Glasgow address and describes a "voluntary team of country editors". The News & Events page says "You do not need to be a WIN Member or Associate to submit news or events to us." The homepage linked linkedin_org; the News & Events page linked events_url. Tags from the same pages.

name: Worker Info Exchange
what: Worker Info Exchange is a non-profit that helps workers reclaim control over data collected from them at work. It uses data access requests, investigations and data trusts to challenge algorithmic management and support legal claims.
source: https://www.workerinfoexchange.org/ (accessed 2026-11-10). Supports name, domain, what, region, website and tags. Homepage quote for what: "Worker Info Exchange is a non-profit helping workers reclaim control over the data collected from them at work." The same page describes its "Data access", "Data investigations" and "Data trusts" work and identifies London in the page title. Tags from the same page.
